build_ViT_model: build a Vision Transformer model with patchify or conv stem for image classification
create_ViTEncoderBlock: create a transformer encoder block with multihead attention and MLP for sequence processing
create_MLPBlock: create an MLP block with gelu activation for transformer feed-forward processing
create_ViTStemConv: create a conv-based ViT stem with configurable kernel sizes, strides, and dimensions
init_weights_vit: initialize ViT model weights using trunc normal, xavier uniform, and normal strategies
